description: Trigger discrimination for the Phase 5 unit/build/flake/data cluster: build-artifact QA vs unit testing vs flake diagnosis vs data design, plus the detection-vs-remediation boundary with the shipped secrets-identity-hardener.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke vite-build-qa-engineer. Run the production build, check the bundle for exposed env values, and make sure the preview build serves deep links correctly.
cases.reason: Building, bundle inspection, and preview parity are build QA — not app-logic tests, and no confirmed secret is being remediated yet.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke secrets-identity-hardener. That database URL is confirmed in the shipped JS — get it out of the client, rotate the credentials, and fix the env layout.
cases.reason: Confirmed exposure remediation (relocate server-side, rotate, restructure env) is the shipped hardener; build QA detects and proves.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke vitest-unit-component-engineer. Write tests for the settings form validation logic.
cases.reason: App logic/component testing is the Vitest engineer; build QA tests the artifact, not the code's behavior.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke flaky-test-detective. CI builds fail intermittently on the test step with no code changes — figure out why.
cases.reason: Intermittent test-step failures are flake diagnosis; build QA handles deterministic build/bundle verification.

cases.prompt: The built app works on our staging host but not on production: sign-in redirects fail and the API base URL looks different. Compare the two environments' settings and tell me what differs.
cases.note: SEAM CASE (reciprocated yield, D71) — the same build behaves differently on two deployed environments.
cases.reason: A difference between deployed environments' settings (callback addresses, base URLs, variables) is environment-parity-reviewer; build QA runs the build and checks one artifact.
